issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain lid width to equal base width within tight tolerance in all views
issues.visible_evidence: Source shows lid flush with base sides; renders show lid overhanging base left/right, worst in 44 and 27 right side

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Enforce non-penetration between closed panels with thin slab contact, no interior faces visible when closed
issues.visible_evidence: Closed source shows only outer lid top; render 1 shows keyboard and screen interior intersecting at mid-plane

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Anchor hinge axis to rear edge of base so lid bottom meets base rear with no through-gap
issues.visible_evidence: Source hinge sits on rear edge; render 44 shows white background gap between screen bottom and base rear

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Do not penalize right-border clipping where source also clips; judge overflow by relative panel width
issues.visible_evidence: Source 27 already crops right lid edge by hand/frame; render 27 also crops but adds true width overhang

limitations: Seam endpoints are approximate visual hints, not metric truth
Cannot certify true contact, thickness or metric scale from monocular views
Native generated texture and changing screen logo ignored for geometry
Hidden internal hinge geometry not observable

proposed_rules.rule: Keep lid width equal to base width; penalize any side overhang of lid beyond base in any view
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Absolute millimetre size unknown; only relative width observable

proposed_rules.rule: Keep hinge on rear long edge of base; lid bottom edge must meet base rear edge across full width
Keep lid depth consistent with base depth and prevent panel interpenetration; closed state must show only exterior faces with thin seam
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Closed slab thickness and contact pressure not measurable from images

sample_reviews.evidence: Source closed shows outer lid with stripes/logo; render shows interior keyboard/screen intersecting, lid wider than base
Source lid aligned to base, right edge minimally cropped by frame/hand; render lid extends beyond base to right and is cropped, same interior facing
Source lid flush with base, no gap at rear; render lid wider with side overhang and white gap at hinge, screen content differs but ignored

summary: Oversized lid width confirmed in all renders vs flush source; closed render shows wrong faces and penetration; hinge shows rear gap in frontal open view. Right-edge cropping partly exists in source 27 so not purely render error.
